(Capacity: 1,250) |champion= |bowl= |bowl_result= }} {{2019–20 Big West men's basketball standings}} The '''2019–20 Cal State Northridge Matadors men's basketball team''' represented [[California State University, Northridge]] in the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Matadors, led by second-year head coach [[Mark Gottfried]], played their home games at the [[Matadome]] in [[Northridge, Los Angeles|Northridge, California]] as members of the [[Big West Conference]]. They finished the season 15–17, 10–6 in Big West play to finish in a tie for second place. They were set to be the No. 2 seed in the [[2020 Big West Conference men's basketball tournament|Big West tournament]]. However, the Big West tournament was canceled amid the [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]]. ==Previous season== The [[2018–19 Cal State Northridge Matadors men's basketball team|Matadors]] finished the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2018–19 season]] 13–21 overall, 7–9 in Big West play, finishing in a tie for 6th place. In the [[2019 Big West Conference men's basketball tournament|Big West tournament]], they were defeated by [[2018–19 UC Santa Barbara Gauchos men's basketball team|UC Santa Barbara]] in the quarterfinals.{{Cite news|url=https://bigwest.org/news/2019/3/15/mens-basketball-no-1-uci-no-2-ucsb-no-3-csf-no-5-lbsu-advance-to-semifinals.aspx|title=No. 1 UCI, No. 2 UCSB, No. 3 CSF, No. 5 LBSU
